findings.title: Preserve the executor-complete fields in the new seal
findings.originalText: When a separately pinned activation is eventually supplied, `verify_central_activation()` still requires `freeze.executorComplete` and `freeze.materialWriteSetComplete` to be `True`, but this generated FIX01 seal omits both fields. Consequently every activation against the archived `source-freeze.json` fails with `BLOCKED_SOURCE_NOT_READY`; the positive authority fixture misses this because it passes a hand-built freeze rather than the generated seal.

findings.title: Freeze contracts that the corrected executor can reproduce
findings.originalText: After a future trusted activation passes, `execute()` recomputes `m16_inputs()` and `build_write_set()` and byte-compares them with these archived tables. Here the input table is the old table plus nine correction-only records, while the write set is the old E16 rules plus eight F01 rules; the recomputed model contains neither those extra inputs nor that ownership layout because `E` now points at F01. Therefore execution always stops at the frozen input/write-set equality checks before any material work, even with a valid activation.
